The ABBV-706 funnel, with its third-line step swapped for the second-line one. SCLC was 11.8% of new US lung cancers in 2019, and 70.9% of SCLC was extensive-stage at diagnosis (Wells et al., JTO Clin Res Rep 2025, doi:10.1016/j.jtocrr.2025.100799, SEER 17; checked against the full text). Of 2,573 US patients with extensive-stage SCLC given first-line platinum, 992 (38.6%) received at least one further line (Sankar et al., Adv Ther 2025, doi:10.1007/s12325-025-03408-z, Flatiron 2018-2023; checked against the full text). 0.118 x 0.709 x 0.386 = 0.0323, about 7,319 patients a year. EMBOLD-SCLC-301 enrols after one platinum + PD-(L)1 line and admits prior tarlatamab, so second and third line. It excludes limited-stage disease at diagnosis, prior topoisomerase-1 ADCs and B7-H3 agents; those exclusions are not taken off. The eligible share of 0.0323 contains ABBV-706's 0.01121, the third-line patients, in full.

The case for: overall survival HR 0.46 against topotecan, median OS 18.5 against 10.3 months, ORR 58.3% against 12.6%, and fewer grade 3+ events (60.9% against 78.2%). Tambotatug pelitecan (YL201, TAISHAN-302) posted the same HR 0.46 on the same day. Imdelltra is entrenched and moving into first line.
